name: comp-292
blurb: Info card with title, description, action button, and dismiss.
description: Static info notification card with blue info icon, bold title, descriptive text, action button, and dismissible close. Larger vertical card layout.
use_when: You need to display informational content with context and an optional action.
avoid_when: For quick info messages or simple alerts; use smaller banner alerts instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
